name: wheel
purpose: A ring of items. With bind, the learner picks one item. With angle, a hand points at a number of degrees over equal sectors (for example 27 nakṣatras), with an optional outer ring (12 rāśis).
keys: ←/→ or A/D, Home/End; in angle mode ⇧ moves ten steps

bind.doc: item mode: the state key of the picked item

angle.doc: angle mode: the state key of a number of degrees, 0 at the top, clockwise

items.doc: the items, in order around the ring

outer.doc: angle mode: labels for an outer ring of equal sectors

step.doc: angle mode: degrees per key press or drag step

marks.doc: angle mode: small marks that cut each sector into this many parts

marks_on.doc: angle mode: show the marks only when this state key is true
